_what: Major integumentary diseases as named perturbations of the package's own T1..T5 / oncology mechanisms; each intervention is the same knob reversed.

actinic_keratosis.anchor: [L] actinic keratosis = the most common UV precursor lesion; high prevalence in sun-damaged skin, low per-lesion progression to invasive cSCC
actinic_keratosis.grade_absolute: [O] absolute prevalence/conversion rate: needs population baseline + dose calibration (oncology obstacle)
actinic_keratosis.intervention: sun protection (lower cumulative dose) + field treatment (cryotherapy / 5-FU / imiquimod clears the damaged field)
actinic_keratosis.mechanism: same multistage kernel as SCC with FEWER hits crossed: AK = early field damage (low-stage, high prevalence), SCC = the full K=5 crossing (rare); only a small per-lesion fraction completes the remaining hits

albinism_OCA.anchor: [L] albinism (OCA): photoprotection-deficient skin shows markedly elevated cSCC/melanoma, especially in high-UV regions
albinism_OCA.grade_absolute: [O] absolute incidence/RR magnitude: needs population baseline rate + absolute dose calibration (oncology obstacle)
albinism_OCA.mechanism: tyrosinase pathway broken -> functional melanin screen removed -> UV reaching DNA stays full -> shared Kramers/multistage hazard rises (RR>1)

atopic_dermatitis.anchor: [L] atopic dermatitis = barrier-defect disease (filaggrin loss-of-function); reduced barrier function, flare-prone
atopic_dermatitis.grade_absolute: [O] absolute TEWL (g/m^2/h): needs lipid permeability D + dC calibration (T1 obstacle)
atopic_dermatitis.mechanism: standing barrier-disruption drive h_base<0 (filaggrin/lipid deficit) eats into the ON-basin: the additional insult to discontinuous collapse (barrier RESERVE) shrinks and baseline TEWL rises

chronic_diabetic_pressure_wound.anchor: [L] chronic wound = failure to re-epithelialise within the expected window (impaired collective migration)
chronic_diabetic_pressure_wound.grade_absolute: [O] absolute closure rate (um/h): needs cell-speed calibration (T2 obstacle)
chronic_diabetic_pressure_wound.intervention: debridement / growth-factor / re-epithelialisation cue (raise unjamming drive above critical)
chronic_diabetic_pressure_wound.mechanism: free-edge unjamming drive held BELOW the package's own chronic-wound critical drive -> edge stays jammed (q<q*) -> non-closure

contact_dermatitis.anchor: [L] contact dermatitis = acute barrier breach from an external irritant/allergen; resolves on removal + barrier repair
contact_dermatitis.grade_absolute: [O] absolute TEWL (g/m^2/h): same calibration obstacle as T1
contact_dermatitis.intervention: irritant avoidance + active barrier repair (re-cross the +spinodal; hysteretic SC rebuild)
contact_dermatitis.mechanism: acute external insult; once it clears the spinodal the barrier collapses DISCONTINUOUSLY (vs atopic's chronic reserve erosion) -- the same T1 switch, acute vs chronic mode

heat_stroke.anchor: [L] heat stroke = thermoregulatory failure; core temperature climbs past a critical band when evaporative capacity is overwhelmed
heat_stroke.grade_absolute: [L]/[O] absolute set-point (37C)/critical 40C: needs heat-capacity calibration (T5 obstacle)
heat_stroke.intervention: rapid external cooling + load reduction (bring load below the runaway onset)
heat_stroke.mechanism: thermal load EXCEEDS the maximum evaporative capacity (sweat saturated at m_max) -> the interface flux cannot balance the load -> core temp runs away (slope jumps after saturation) -- the same T5 regulator, capacity overwhelmed

hypohidrotic_ectodermal_dysplasia.anchor: [L] hypohidrotic ectodermal dysplasia (EDAR pathway): reduced/absent sweat glands -> hyperthermia / heat intolerance
hypohidrotic_ectodermal_dysplasia.grade_absolute: [L]/[O] absolute set-point (37C) + sweat rate: need per-gland + heat-capacity calibration (T5 obstacle)
hypohidrotic_ectodermal_dysplasia.intervention: external cooling (cap thermal load below the disease danger onset)
hypohidrotic_ectodermal_dysplasia.mechanism: EDAR loss caps max sweat capacity m_max -> evaporative interface flux limited -> at a given heat load the core runs hotter and the heat-stroke band is reached at a LOWER load

ichthyosis.anchor: [L] ichthyosis = retention hyperkeratosis: impaired desquamation, thickened stratum corneum
ichthyosis.grade_absolute: [O] absolute SC residence days: needs per-cell desquamation-rate calibration (T4 obstacle)
ichthyosis.intervention: keratolytic / retinoid (restore a strong shedding drive past the spinodal)
ichthyosis.mechanism: desquamation needs a drive past the spinodal; as the shedding drive approaches the spinodal the shed (flip-OFF) time DIVERGES (critical slowing) -> stratum-corneum retention -- the opposite turnover sign to psoriasis on the same R19 switch

melasma_hyperpigmentation.anchor: [L] melasma = acquired focal hypermelanosis driven by hormones and UV; partially reversible with photoprotection + depigmenting therapy
melasma_hyperpigmentation.grade_absolute: [O] absolute melanin optical density: needs extinction-coefficient calibration (T3 obstacle)
melasma_hyperpigmentation.intervention: depigmenting agents / photoprotection / remove hormonal driver (lower the synthesis drive)
melasma_hyperpigmentation.mechanism: a standing pro-melanogenic drive (hormonal/UV/inflammatory) raises the REGULATED melanin steady state above baseline -- the opposite-sign pole to vitiligo on the same MITF switch

primary_hyperhidrosis.anchor: [L] primary focal hyperhidrosis = sweating beyond thermoregulatory need; responds to threshold-raising therapies
primary_hyperhidrosis.grade_absolute: [O] absolute sweat rate: needs per-gland calibration (T5 obstacle)
primary_hyperhidrosis.grade_shape: [V] lowered recruitment threshold (opposite pole of HED)
primary_hyperhidrosis.intervention: antiperspirant / anticholinergic / botulinum toxin (raise the effective recruitment threshold)
primary_hyperhidrosis.mechanism: the sweat RECRUITMENT threshold theta_on is lowered (sympathetic overactivity) -> the gland engages at a far lower thermal load -> sweating disproportionate to need -- the opposite-sign pole to HED on the same EDAR sweat switch

psoriasis.anchor: [L] psoriasis: epidermal transit accelerated to ~3-5 d vs ~28-40 d healthy (several-fold hyperproliferation)
psoriasis.grade_absolute: [O] absolute transit DAYS: needs per-cell + whole-conveyor calibration (T4 obstacle); the package does not predict the absolute basal cycle time
psoriasis.intervention: anti-proliferative (lower exit drive below the differentiation spinodal)
psoriasis.mechanism: proliferative exit drive past the differentiation spinodal makes the basal cell advance autonomously; below the spinodal it is held on the homeostatic conveyor. THRESHOLD + critical speeding = graded hyperproliferation

skin_cancer_melanoma_scc_bcc.anchor: [L] Gandini 2005 meta: melanoma intermittent SRR 1.61; chronic occupational inverse; SCC near-linear in cumulative UV; Armitage-Doll K~5
skin_cancer_melanoma_scc_bcc.grade_absolute: [O] absolute incidence/RR magnitude: needs population baseline + absolute dose calibration
skin_cancer_melanoma_scc_bcc.intervention: reduce UV intensity/dose; avoid intermittent sunburn; sun protection (restore screen)
skin_cancer_melanoma_scc_bcc.mechanism: carcinogen = sustained R19 drive -> barrier-lowering -> Kramers crossing ~ exp(|h_c|/spinodal) -> multistage K=5 -> RR(dose); pigment loss removes the screen that blunts a burst

vitiligo.anchor: [L] vitiligo = autoimmune melanocyte loss: depigmented, photoprotection-deficient patches; repigmentation requires active phototherapy
vitiligo.grade_absolute: [O] absolute melanin optical density: needs extinction-coefficient calibration (T3 obstacle)
vitiligo.intervention: narrowband UVB / immunomodulation (active stimulation re-crosses the +spinodal; hysteresis = repigmentation is hard)
vitiligo.mechanism: autoimmune drive pushes the melanocyte VIABILITY (R19 presence switch) below the spinodal -> melanocyte lost discontinuously -> melanin->0 regardless of UV -> photoprotection lost (UV reaching DNA returns to full)
